meta.frame: each item in its own frame: z up, the front -y; origins as each item says (wall things: the middle of the back on the wall; desk / ground things: the middle of the underside; panel things: on the panel face, +z out; pipe pieces: on the axis)
meta.unity: (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, -y); angle -> -angle; box size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy); the item's front (-y) is the prefab's +Z

materials.atlas: M_Kit_Kit (T_Kit_Kit_A_px: the baked PSX atlas of every model, point filter)
materials.panel: M_Kit_Panel (T_Kit_Panel_A_px + _E_px: labels, signs, the dial, the camera glass)
materials.lamps: M_Kit_Lamp_<Red|Green|Amber|Beacon> lit / _Off (same textures, emission on / off)
materials.screen: M_Kit_Screen_Off (T_Kit_Screen_Off) / M_Kit_Screen_On (the camera picture; T_Kit_Screen_On stands in)

wire.note: parabola through the two attach points: p(t) = A + (B - A) t - up * 4 sag t (1 - t), t = 0..1; sag = max(sag_min, sag_k * L^2), L = the horizontal span; segments = max(seg_min, ceil(L / seg_len)); a tube of `sides` sides and radius r_lv (service drop, black, M_Kit_Wire) or r_bare (line wires, M_Kit_WireBare)

battery.note: the van's Battery (Van/Data/parts.json): size (x, up, z) in its Unity frame, posts at (+-x, up, z) = (0.04, 0.217, -+0.105)

meta.instances: a building links the item's collection from snow_kit.blend and places an instance empty KIT_... at the item's origin; in Unity the builder puts the item's prefab on that empty (the FBX has no references)
